_comment: Train-vs-UCI run registry — a THIRD run type alongside corpus-replay (registry.json) and self-play (selfplay_registry.json). These runs train against external UCI engines (Stockfish/Sloppy) as move oracles, distilling both sides' play into the replay buffer — not corpus replay, not self-play. vsuci.py parses [VS-UCI] step lines from each segment's log into data/<key>.csv using the SAME shared schema (_schema.FIELDS). Unlike self-play, vs-UCI HAS a full per-1000-step pElo/nll trajectory: probes were run live at each -latest autosave and stored in `pelo_jsonl` (keyed by cumulative step). A warm restart (train-vs-uci reloads weights only; optimizer/buffer/step reset) begins a new segment; cum_step = segment.cumstep_base + meta_step. type=vsuci distinguishes these from the other two.

sf100sl100._timing_comment: elapsed_train_sec corrections. (1) IDLE is removed automatically everywhere: when a logged interval's wall-clock delta exceeds steps*ms, the excess is time the CPU was not running (system sleep/suspend) and is not training time. (2) THROTTLE rescaling is applied ONLY inside the declared throttled_windows below, because a slow step cannot be distinguished from a throttled one by duration alone -- seg1 contains legitimate ~9s stalls that must NOT be rescaled away. Inside a declared window, any interval slower than throttle_trigger x baseline_ms_per_step is rescaled to baseline; faster intervals are left untouched.
